subject.title: fix(ollama): preserve custom memory provider endpoints

question: Should this PR intentionally invalidate existing Ollama memory provider keys so endpoint and tenant-routing identity become correct, accepting a one-time index rebuild for current users?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish correctness, but repository policy treats persisted identity and operator-action changes as an owner decision; code review cannot choose the acceptable upgrade cost.

options.title: Accept one-time rebuild
options.body: Merge the current approach and treat the proven normal index rebuild as the supported upgrade path for endpoint-correct caches.

options.title: Reduce default-user churn
options.body: Require a compatibility-preserving key shape for canonical default Ollama settings while still changing identity for custom endpoints or identity-bearing headers.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Keep current cache identity until maintainers choose a broader persisted-index migration strategy.

recommendation.title: Accept one-time rebuild
recommendation.body: Merge the current approach and treat the proven normal index rebuild as the supported upgrade path for endpoint-correct caches.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest merged history on prior Ollama endpoint-aware cache identity and its shipped behavior.
